clearAfterSave.label: Clear Buffer After Saving
clearAfterSave.description: Each saved clip only contains footage since the last save. Turn off to always save the full buffer duration.

codec.label: Codec
codec.secondaryGpuHint: Runs on a different GPU than your main one

stretch4by3.label: Stretch 4:3 to 16:9
stretch4by3.description: Games running at a 4:3 resolution fill the whole video instead of getting black bars.

hdr.label: Record in HDR
hdr.description: Keeps HDR brightness and color, but videos can look washed out on screens without HDR. When off, HDR is converted to SDR.

gpuPriority.label: Realtime GPU Priority
gpuPriority.description: Keeps recordings smooth in GPU-heavy games. When off, the game gets a few more FPS but recordings can stutter.

monitor.usage: Used for manual recordings and the always-on replay buffer.

session.title: Session Recording
session.description: Records each game from launch to close as one video.

buffer.title: Replay Buffer
buffer.description: Keeps the last {{length}} of gameplay in memory so you can save it as a clip.

hybrid.title: Hybrid (Session + Buffer)
hybrid.description: Records each game as one video and lets you save the last {{length}} as a clip.

alwaysOn.label: Always-on Replay Buffer
alwaysOn.description: Keeps a replay buffer of your display running when no game is recording. Press <hotkey/> to save the last {{length}} as a clip.

discardSessions.label: Discard Sessions Without Bookmarks
discardSessions.description: Deletes a session recording when it ends unless you added a bookmark with the hotkey. Kills and other automatic bookmarks don't count.

splitMatches.label: Split Sessions Into Matches
splitMatches.description: Saves each match as its own session and deletes the time in menus between matches.

enable.label: Record Webcam
enable.description: Records your camera as a separate layer. Move, resize or hide it in the editor, and clips include it while it is shown.
